opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ordinarily resident in Scotland and enrolled on (or holding an unconditional offer for) an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution, who are not eligible for government tuition fee funding.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding covering tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for students from low-income households studying an undergraduate degree at a Scottish higher education institution who are ineligible for government tuition fee support.
